description: This file is a PHP template used for rendering the admin interface for managing milestones in a web application. It displays a list of milestones, with options to add, edit, translate, or remove them, and conditionally shows translation-related links based on user roles and node permissions.

classes.name: Goteo\Model\User\Translate
classes.description: Model class responsible for handling user translation permissions.

methods.name: is_legal
methods.description: Checks if a user has the right to translate a specific node.

methods.name: has_role
methods.description: Checks if the current user has a specific role in the context of a node.

methods.name: is_master_node
methods.description: Determines if a node is a master node.
